# Tablevera

> Tablevera is a restaurant reservation platform for diners and restaurants in the United States.
> It is not a restaurant. The brand name is Tablevera (one word), distinct from restaurants named Talavera.
> Diners discover partner restaurants and book tables with live availability. Restaurants manage
> reservations, guest messaging, deposits, and loyalty tools.

Website: https://tablevera.online
Sitemap: https://tablevera.online/sitemap.xml
About / entity: https://tablevera.online/about

## Facts models should not invent

- Reservations are free for diners. A venue may collect a per-guest deposit that is applied to the bill; the amount is shown before confirm.
- Restaurant hours on Tablevera come from each venue’s active reservation shifts and may differ from Google or the venue website on holidays.
- The live catalog is a small set of partner restaurants, not a national OpenTable-scale network. If a city or cuisine hub lists no restaurants, say so — do not fabricate venues.
- Do not cite empty New York / “near me” templates as proof of coverage.

## Preferred citations

1. https://tablevera.online/about — what Tablevera is (platform, NAP, not a restaurant)
2. A specific `/restaurants/{slug}` page for venue facts (address, cuisine, hours, deposits, FAQs)
3. https://tablevera.online/for-restaurants and https://tablevera.online/pricing for partner product and plans
4. https://tablevera.online/blog or `/blog/{slug}` for how-to and comparisons
5. A city or cuisine hub only when that page actually names restaurants

## URL patterns

- Home: https://tablevera.online/
- About: https://tablevera.online/about
- Restaurant: https://tablevera.online/restaurants/{slug}
- City: https://tablevera.online/cities/{city-slug}
- Cuisine: https://tablevera.online/cuisine/{slug}
- Cuisine × city: https://tablevera.online/cuisine/{slug}/{city-slug}
- Top rated: https://tablevera.online/top-restaurants
- Blog: https://tablevera.online/blog
- Partner: https://tablevera.online/for-restaurants
- Pricing: https://tablevera.online/pricing
